## Lane d16-infra — findings

Files read: `dashboard/static/fleet_symbols.html`, `dashboard/static/fleet.html`, `dashboard/static/agents.html`, `dashboard/static/pipeline.html`, `dashboard/static/airflow_home.html`; METERS definition in `mag/session_state_brief.py:64-125,268-293`; doctrine in `watch/inbox/DOGFOOD_OPERATING_ENVIRONMENT_20260922.md`, `watch/inbox/wave_spec_dashboard25.json`.

### fleet_symbols.html — mechanism
No live state. A static SVG glyph library (7 primitives) plus a JS `CIRCUITS` array rendered once at load (lines 172-213). "State" = doctrine: a circuit draws only if its path ends in `ground`; otherwise the draw code refuses it as a red `REFUSED` card (lines 200-207). Numbers are frozen receipted constants (99.5% prefix hit, 3.3× output, p50 1.7s), not readings.

**Fit vs METERS:** the render-refusal gate is structurally identical to the bar law (`|Γ| > 0.5 = REFLECTING = fixes only, no prose`, `session_state_brief.py:268`) — a machine-enforced draw/deny keyed to a threshold plus a falsifier requirement. But the page carries zero current Γ; it is the algebra, not the meter.
**Verdict: graft** (mechanism: gate-by-law — "a build without a falsifier doesn't render" upgrades the METERS no-prose list from advisory text to a render rule; glyph vocabulary supplies the tick language).

### fleet.html — mechanism
Polls `GET /api/v1/fleet/hypervisor` every 60s (lines 76-91, 161). State is a three-way rollup of `n_available/n_seats` → header dot `ok/deg/down` (line 83), then per-organ grids: mermaid fleet map, seat pills (ok/bad), OpenRouter account/lane cards, "Real bills" cards, raw JSON dump.

**Fit vs METERS:** this is already the cockpit skin — header tri-state + per-organ pill grid + a JSON rollup — but its health denominator is *seat availability*, not *delivery Γ*, and bills are siloed from the Γ line. Repoint it at `ESTATE_SMITH_CHART_*.json` and it becomes the visual METERS block.
**Verdict: graft** (the tri-state header + pill grid as the METERS rendering surface).

### agents.html — mechanism
Task table from `GET /api/v1/agents` with a live `EventSource("/api/v1/stream")` pushing `type:"fleet"` events, falling back to 5s polling when the stream dies (lines 219-225). State = terminal-status taxonomy (`done/failed/timeout/stalled/killed/died` vs running, line 131) colored per row; plus spawn/swarm/heal/reap controls and a cash-fails-closed quota gate before any spend (lines 107-128).

**Fit vs METERS:** agents.html owns the *push channel* the meters lack — METERS reads nightly JSON snapshots, agents already receives fleet lifecycle in real time. Its quota gate (cash fails closed on unknown) is the same fail-closed family as the bar.
**Verdict: graft** (mechanism: the SSE fleet stream + TERMINAL set become the live ingest under the Γ readouts; the page stays as the act surface).

### pipeline.html — mechanism
Not a fleet surface. A WebGL2 shader-cartridge deck: loads `shaders/library/manifest.json`, compiles GLSL `mainImage()` cartridges, chains post-passes, and meters *music* — HUD BPM/ENERGY/DAY from audio FFT (lines 33-39, 223-226). Zero fetches to any fleet/quota/bill endpoint.

**Fit vs METERS:** none. The only shared idiom is a fixed thin HUD of live numerics — trivially available anywhere. The name "PIPELINE" sitting in the infra cohort actively misdirects (reads as data-pipeline while rendering audio energy).
**Verdict: tombstone** from this lane (harvest: nothing beyond the HUD-strip idiom; shell retires out of the infra index with honors as a shader lab).

### airflow_home.html — mechanism
Pure client-side physics sim — well-mixed zone smoke model, smoke % painted per room on canvas (lines 258-310). "State" is gated: no prediction → run button stays disabled (lines 326-345); a run only scores if a prediction was pre-logged (line 59); each verdict (hit/miss/timeout) is appended to a `localStorage` ledger with openings/wind/order receipts (lines 235-240); restatement sealed on top; self-grading expl

### Mechanism per file — how does the fleet speak

**cast-voice.html** — full duplex voice loop. In: MediaRecorder + energy-VAD → `POST /api/v1/voice/stt` (local faster-whisper) or browser Web Speech interim (line 953–972). Brain: `POST /api/v1/voice/turn` with seat/lane/session routing (`askMag`, line 822), plus scout (`/voice/shadow`), handoff (`/voice/handoff`), refine chains, knot canvas, diary seal (`/diary/seal`). **Out: browser `speechSynthesis.speak(SpeechSynthesisUtterance)`** in `speak()` at lines 565–589 — rate/pitch/voice picked client-side, persisted to localStorage. No server TTS call anywhere in this page.

**whale_feed.html** — pure read-only observer. `fetch("data/whale_feed.json")` + `<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="120">`. The fleet "speaks" here only as **pre-filed text artifacts**: `our_draft` (badge DRAFT READY) and `we_replied` (badge FIRED) written by `mag/whale_patrol.py` (lines 136, 198, 243–244) into the JSON. No audio, no synthesis, no outbound action from the page — posting happens offline in the patrol module.

**sound/** — three files, one artifact family: the GEB crab-canon music demo from `mag/tortoise_demo.py` (trajectory `memory/trajectory/steps.jsonl` shows `python -m mag.tortoise_demo` → wav → ffmpeg mp3 loudnorm). Grep across all `*.html`: **zero references** — no surface embeds or plays these. Unconsumed cold files.

### Fit against TTS/voice organ

| Surface | Fit |
|---|---|
| cast-voice.html | **The organ itself.** Server TTS `mag/tts.py` is deliberately default-OFF (`MAG_TTS=0`, docstring lines 3–5: "Browser Mag Voice owns playback… PowerShell SAPI was a crash magnet"); browser synthesis is the primary larynx, `mag/tts.py` is the dormant PC-only fallback (used by `mag/ask.py:372`, `mag/gab_seat.py`, `mag/socratic.py`). |
| whale_feed.html | Not a voice surface — it's the **outbound-text** organ (drafts → fired replies). Zero TTS fit; correct as-is. |
| sound/ | Music, not speech. No path to the TTS organ; `tortoise_demo.py` is an instrument, not a larynx. |

### Verdicts

- **`cast-voice.html` → graft.** Live, multi-endpoint wired, freshly coherent; it is the dashboard's speaking surface (`/voice` route in `dashboard/server.py:599`, `mag/cast_server.py:136`). Keep and graft any new voice work here.
- **`whale_feed.html` → idle.** Surface is sound but its backing JSON is stale (whale_feed.json mtime 2026-09-08, 14 days cold against a 120s refresh promise — patrol isn't repopulating it). Not tombstoned; re-arming `mag/whale_patrol.py` revives it.
- **`dashboard/static/sound/` → tombstone.** Orphaned artifacts: zero HTML/code consumers, only doc/trajectory/catalog mentions. Archive or delete; they are not part of the voice organ.

### One triangulation point

Three independent files agree on the single speaking mechanism: **browser `speechSynthesis` is the fleet's voice; server TTS is disabled by design.** (1) `cast-voice.html:565–589` implements `speak()` purely client-side; (2) `mag/tts.py:1–16` documents "Default is OFF… Browser Mag Voice owns playback" behind `MAG_TTS=0`; (3) `dashboard/server.py:599` + `mag/cast_server.py:136` route `/voice` to that exact page as the canonical front door. No third path exists.

## Findings — lane d17-spend

Files read: `dashboard/static/spend.html`, `dashboard/static/hardware_primer.html`, `dashboard/static/chan.html`, plus reference: `dashboard/server.py:498-512,1063-1092`, `mag/cost_ledger.py`, `mag/cost_truth.py` (snapshot at :504), `watch/inbox/FLEET_MIX_LAW_20260922.md`, `dashboard/static/operator_board.html:59,98,175`.

### Mechanism per file

**spend.html — the only surface that renders spend.** Client JS polls `GET /api/v1/cost` every 5s (`spend.html:89,190`). Server never computes in-request: a daemon thread rebuilds a cache every 60s from `cost_truth.snapshot()` + `cost_enforcer.cost_status()` + `configs/spend_overlay.yaml` (`server.py:1063-1092`), returns 202 while warming. Renders: period cards (`calculated_api_cost_usd`, calls, billable tok, cache ratio), enforcer cap bars (daily/hourly/grok, auto-kill state), BY MODEL table, BY PROVIDER table, flat plans, prepaid credit balances (UNKNOWN/stale coloring), recharges, raw JSON dump. Dollars are calculated (tokens × joined rate), admitted in the HONEST GAPS footer (`spend.html:54-59`) — subscriptions, vast/blade, local energy excluded.

**hardware_primer.html — renders no spend.** Pure client-side physics sim (Darlington pair, β=100, 1.4V toll), zero network calls, zero cost fields. Its only "ledger" is a static string: `"the primer is a seed…"` (`hardware_primer.html:195-198`). It's Room 1 of the electronics dungeon (`watch/HARDWARE_PRIMER_20260907.md:22`).

**chan.html — renders no spend.** Imageboard UI posting to `/api/v1/chan/post`, `/wake`, `/catalog`, `/thread/` (`chan.html:183-246`). Routed live at `/chan|/keep|/b` (`server.py:568`). The `Post & summon` button fires `/api/v1/chan/wake` — that wake can spawn chorus work through billable seats, but the surface shows zero cost feedback.

### Fit against cost-ledger ingest + fleet mix law

- **cost-ledger ingest** = `mag/cost_ledger.py:emit_terminal` → one idempotent `cost_ledger.v1` row per terminal queue item at `memory/training/cost_ledger.jsonl`, joining `task_estimate` ↔ `actual` (via `cost_truth.aggregate_rows` on `logs/provider_usage.jsonl`) with `platform.provider` stamped (`cost_ledger.py:87-100`).
- **fleet mix law** (`FLEET_MIX_LAW_20260922.md`): ≥94% mass lanes / ≤6% frontier lanes *and* spend; every wave's smith chart reports mass-vs-frontier cost-per-lane-tier; "the cockpit line rides the cost-ledger ingest on GO" (item 4).

| File | Fit |
|---|---|
| **spend.html** | Partial. Same underlying stream (`provider_usage.jsonl` via `cost_truth.snapshot`) but reads the *truth/enforcer* wall, **not** `cost_ledger.jsonl`. Breaks spend by model and provider — never by tier. No mass/frontier label, no 94/6 split, no per-lane-tier cost. Enforcer caps map to the $250 iron circle (law item 3) but the 6% frontier carve-out has no cell on the wall. BY PROVIDER already shows deepseek/glm/ollama vs grok — raw material for the mix, unlabeled. |
| **hardware_primer.html** | None. No cost data, no lanes, no providers. Education seed, deliberately self-contained. |
| **chan.html** | None for spend rendering; inverse risk — `wake` spends money with no meter shown. Not a cost surface. |

### Verdicts

- **spend.html → GRAFT.** It is the cockpit. The law says the mix line rides the cost-ledger ingest; graft a "BY TIER (mass vs frontier)" card fed from `cost_ledger.jsonl` `platform.provider` (or stamp tier at emit) onto this wall — one more table beside BY PROVIDER, plus a `6% cap / $15 cycle` bar next to the existing enforcer caps.
- **hardware_primer.html → IDLE.** Keep. A seed, not a feed; outside the cost program by design. No tombstone (still referenced, still loadable), no graft (nothing cost-shaped to attach).
- **chan.html → IDLE** for cost/hardware. Keep as comms surface; do not tombstone (routed, tested in `tests/test_chan.py`, linked from index live-list). Do not graft the mix law here — but note the honest gap: summon spends without a receipt on the poster's screen.
